svg.title: Tuvok Hero Board — editable SVG
svg.desc: 4500 × 2700 px board. Panel frames, header fills, titles, rules, and labels are vector shapes and editable text. Only the starfield, individual ability artwork, and separate icon assets are raster images.

g.inkscape:label: 02 - Editable vector panels, titles, and rules
Rules line
g.text: Increase Logic stack limit by 1, gain
Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action
of any kind may be performed by an opponent until the ability fully completes.
